summary: Female ice climber at the South Park area of the Ouray Ice Park struck in the back and shoulder by falling ice while tying in. A 14-person OMRT field team raised her up the cliff by rope and got her to an ambulance; she refused transport.
notes: Ice-fall strike while tying in; patient refused ambulance transport. 2026-09-20: merged OMRT FB post permalink (CAVEAT — 'recent technical rescue in the Ouray Ice Park' posted 2022-02-10, falling-ice ha).
